item.title: Jurassic Park computers in excruciating detail
item.description:
📝 Dennis Nedry's desk is an indescribable mess with three machines (two macs, one SGI), three monitors, one PDA, and storage devices. Dennis Nedry's powerhouse workstation is an SGI IRIS Crimson. The Motorola Envoy is a personal digital assistant used by Dennis.
🔗 Read more: https://fabiensanglard.net/jurrasic_park_computers/index.html
